quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 20 feet of a driveway entrance to any fire station and, on the side of a highway opposite the entrance to any fire station, within 75 feet of that entrance.

activation.condition: A person stops, stands or parks a vehicle at a fire-station driveway entrance, on either highway side as the clause specifies.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park within the applicable fire-station entrance distance unless an exception applies.
